sections.heading: Description
lines: Volcanic Top Field is one of the Field Effects present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as a Telluric field and can be found on the Valor Summit.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: Infernal Field will transform into this field if the moves Judgment, Origin Pulse or Purify are used.
“The hellish landscape was purified!”
Mountain will transform into this field if the moves Eruption, Lava Plume, Magma Drift, or the Z-Move Inferno Overdrive are used.
“The mountain erupted!”
Snowy Mountain will transform into this field if the moves Eruption or Magma Drift are used.
“The mountain erupted!”

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Fire-type moves → 1.5x boost.
“The attack was super-heated!”
Flying-type moves → 1.5x boost.
“The mountain strengthened the attack!!”
Rock-type moves → 1.5x boost, Fire sub-typing.
Water-type moves → 0.9x decrease.
“The extreme heat softened the attack...”
Hydro Steam, Scald & Steam Eruption are exempt from this effect.
Ice-type moves → 0.5x decrease.
“The extreme heat softened the attack...”
Hail & Snow are terminated.
“The hail melted away.”
“The snow melted away.”
While Strong Winds are active:
Special Flying-type moves → 1.5x boost (stacks with general buff to Flying-type moves for a 2.25x multiplier).
Wind-based moves → 1.5x boost (does not stack with the aforementionned boost to special Flying-type moves in Strong Winds).
Eruptions:
Various moves and abilities will cause the volcano to erupt at the end of the turn, with the following effects:
All non Fire-type Pokémon take Fire-type scaling damage, with normal damage equal to 1/8 max HP.
“[Pokémon] is hurt by the eruption!”
Sleeping Pokémon are woken up, unless they have the ability Soundproof.
“[Pokémon] woke up due to the eruption!”
All Entry Hazards & Leech Seed are removed.
“The eruption removed all hazards from the field!”
“[Pokémon]'s Leech Seed burned away in the eruption!”
Causes of eruptions:
Bulldoze, Earth Power, Earthquake, Eruption, Fever Pitch, Lava Plume, Magma Drift, Magnitude & Precipice Blades cause the volcano to erupt.
“The volcano is going to erupt!”
The ability Desolate Land causes the volcano to erupt at the end of every turn as long as it's active.

sections.heading: General Effects (continued)
lines: Eruption-related Abilities:

Battle Armor, Blaze, Flame Body, Flare Boost, Flash Fire, Magic Guard, Magma Armor, Prism Armor, Shell Armor, Solid Rock, Sturdy, Water Bubble & Wonder Guard protect their bearer from eruption damage.
“[Pokémon] is immune to the eruption!”
As of v14.0.22, despite what is stated in the in-game Field Notes, Steam Engine does not protect the user from eruption damage.
Thick Fat halves eruption damage the bearer takes.
This does not stack with Thick Fat's reduction of Fire-type damage; Eruption's normal damage on a Pokémon with Thick Fat is 1/16, not 1/32.
Blaze & Flash Fire are activated after an eruption.
As of v14.0.22, despite what is stated in the in-game Field Notes, Steam Engine is not activated after an eruption.
Flare Boost raises the bearer's Special Attack by 1 stage after an eruption.
Magma Armor raises the bearer's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage after an eruption.
Eruption-related Moves:
Aqua Ring, Arenite Wall & Wide Guard protect affected Pokémon from eruption damage.
“[Pokémon] is immune to the eruption!”
As of v14.0.22, Arenite Wall isn't listed in the in-game Field Notes.
Pokémon affected by Tar Shot take 2x eruption damage.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Activated Abilities:
Gale Wings (if Strong Winds are active)
Buffed Abilities:
Coal Furnace activates and raises the user's Speed by 1 stage at the end of the turn.
As of v14.0.22, this interaction isn't listed in the in-game Field Notes.
Fire Mane increases the power of affected moves by 2x instead of 1.5x.
Ice Face melts on entry.
As of v14.0.22, the in-game Field Notes incorrectly state it melts at the end of the turn.
Long Reach boosts damage dealt by the user by 1.5x.
As of v14.0.22, this interaction isn't listed in the in-game Field Notes.
Magma Armor protects the bearer from Fire-type moves.
Rocky Payload increases damage of the user's Rock-type moves by 2x instead of 1.5x.
As of v14.0.22, this interaction isn't listed in the in-game Field Notes.
Steam Engine raises the bearer's Speed by 1 stage at the end of each turn.
Wind Power & Wind Rider activate at the end of each turn if Strong Winds are active.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Damage Modifiers: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Clear Smog, Gust, Icy Wind, Ominous Wind, Precipice Blades, Razor Wind, Silver Wind, Smog, Twister → 1.5x boost, Fire sub-typing.
“The field super-heated the attack!”
Thunder → 1.5x boost, never misses.
“The field powers up the attack!”
Hydro Steam, Infernal Parade, Scald, Steam Eruption → 1.5x boost.
“The field super-heated the attack!”
“The field powers up the flaming attacks!”
Eruption, Heat Wave, Lava Plume, Magma Drift, Magma Storm → 1.2x boost
“The field powers up the flaming attacks!”
Moves which receive an attack nerf:
Hydro Pump, Hydro Vortex, Muddy Water, Oceanic Operetta, Sparkling Aria, Surf, Water Pledge, Water Spout → 0.5x decrease.
“Steam shot up from the field!”
These moves and Water Sport generate steam, lowering all active Pokémon's Accuracy by 1 stage.
Other moves: Buffed Moves:
Burn Up's effect resets at the end of the turn.
Poison Gas badly poisons the targets.
Raging Fury ends after 1 turn and does not confuse the user.
Smokescreen lowers the target's Accuracy by 2 stages.
Tailwind lasts 6 turns and creates Strong Winds for its duration.
Other Move Changes:
Dig, Dive, Egg Bomb, Explosion, Magnet Bomb, Seismic Toss and Self-Destruct gain a Fire sub-typing.
Outrage, Petal Dance & Thrash end after 1 turn.
Stealth Rock deals Fire-type scaling damage instead.
“Molten stones dug into [Pokémon]!”
Field-dependent moves & Abilities:
Mimicry changes the bearer's type to Fire.
Camouflage changes the user's type to Fire.
Nature Power becomes Eruption.
Secret Power may inflict Burn.
Shelter halves damage from Fire-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Fire.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost on top of any other previously listed modifiers.
This field will transform into Sky Field if the moves Bounce or Fly are used.
“The battle was taken to the skies!”
This field will transform into Mountain Field if the moves Blizzard, Glaciate, or the Z-Move Subzero Slammer are used.
“The field cooled off!”

sections.heading: Items
lines: Telluric Seed raises the user's Defense by 1 stage and applies Shell Trap to them.
“[Pokémon] primed a trap!”

sections.heading: Notes
lines: Prior to V14, several effects were different on this field:
Fire-type moves increased in base power by 1.2x.
Flying-type moves increased in base power by 1.3x.
Steam-creating moves (Hydro Pump, Hydro Vortex, ...) saw a 0.625x decrease in power instead of the current 0.5x.
Prior to V14, the field quote was "The mountain top is super-heated!"
